Exactly two arms/two hands, clear shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist connections. No changing fan hand. Keep fan fully OPEN with rigid ribs, same ivory material and blue dragon drawing.
1254x1254 native square RGBA transparent single-frame. Retain input1 whole-canvas scale: head size unchanged; pelvis around(650,800); virtual floor y1191; fixed boots on same floor positions, front LEFT boot around(365,1130) and rear RIGHT boot around(1075,1120).
